passages.text: Then Job answered: “How you have helped the powerless and saved the arm that is feeble!
passages.sermon:
Job spoke.
Job answered.
Job said these words.
You helped the powerless.
You saved the arm that is weak.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃ מֶה־ עָזַ֥רְתָּ לְלֹא־ כֹ֑חַ ה֝וֹשַׁ֗עְתָּ זְר֣וֹעַ לֹא־ עֹֽז׃

passages.text: How you have counseled the unwise and provided fully sound insight!
passages.sermon:
Job speaks to his friend.
Job addresses a person who gives advice.
You have given advice to someone who has no wisdom.
You have made understanding known in great measure.
You have explained much understanding.
passages.original: מַה־ יָּ֭עַצְתָּ לְלֹ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝תוּשִׁיָּ֗ה לָרֹ֥ב הוֹדָֽעְתָּ׃

passages.text: To whom have you uttered these words? And whose spirit spoke through you?
passages.sermon:
Job speaks to his friends.
Job asks a question.
Job says, "To whom did you speak these words?"
Job asks, "Whose spirit came out from you?"
passages.original: אֶת־ מִ֭י הִגַּ֣דְתָּ מִלִּ֑ין וְנִשְׁמַת־ מִ֝י יָצְאָ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

passages.text: The dead tremble— those beneath the waters and those who dwell in them.
passages.sermon: The dead tremble.\r\nThey are beneath the waters.\r\nThose who dwell beneath the waters also tremble.

passages.text: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
passages.sermon:
God sees everything.
Sheol is completely exposed to God.
Abaddon has nothing to hide itself from God.
Nothing is hidden from God in Sheol or Abaddon.
passages.original: עָר֣וֹם שְׁא֣וֹל נֶגְדּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָֽאֲבַדּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: He stretches out the north over empty space; He hangs the earth upon nothing.
passages.sermon:
God acts with great power.
God stretches out the northern sky over empty space.
God hangs the earth on nothing.
God does not use anything to support the earth.
passages.original: נֹטֶ֣ה צָפ֣וֹן עַל־ תֹּ֑הוּ תֹּ֥לֶה אֶ֝֗רֶץ עַל־ בְּלִי־ מָֽה׃

passages.text: He wraps up the waters in His clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their own weight.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful.
God gathers water in His clouds.
The clouds hold the water.
The clouds do not break from the weight.
God keeps the clouds strong.
passages.original: צֹרֵֽר־ מַ֥יִם בְּעָבָ֑יו וְלֹא־ נִבְקַ֖ע עָנָ֣ן תַּחְתָּֽם׃

passages.text: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading over it His cloud.
passages.sermon: God acts with power and wisdom.\r\nGod covers the face of the full moon.\r\nGod spreads His cloud over the moon.
passages.original: מְאַחֵ֥ז פְּנֵי־ כִסֵּ֑ה פַּרְשֵׁ֖ז עָלָ֣יו עֲנָנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He has inscribed a horizon on the face of the waters at the boundary between light and darkness.
passages.sermon:
God acts with power and wisdom.
God marks a boundary on the surface of the waters.
This boundary is the horizon.
The horizon separates light from darkness.
passages.original: חֹֽק־ חָ֭ג עַל־ פְּנֵי־ מָ֑יִם עַד־ תַּכְלִ֖ית א֣וֹר עִם־ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

passages.text: The foundations of heaven quake, astounded at His rebuke.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful.
He rebukes with authority.
The foundations of heaven shake when He rebukes.
The foundations of heaven feel fear.
The foundations of heaven are amazed by His rebuke.

passages.text: By His power He stirred the sea; by His understanding He shattered Rahab.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful.
God used His power to stir the sea.
God is wise.
God used His understanding to shatter Rahab.
passages.original: בְּ֭כֹחוֹ רָגַ֣ע הַיָּ֑ם וּבִתוּבְנָתוֹ מָ֣חַץ רָֽהַב׃

passages.text: By His breath the skies were cleared; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful and wise.
God acts with authority over creation.
God cleared the skies by His breath.
God pierced the fleeing serpent with His hand.
passages.original: בְּ֭רוּחוֹ שָׁמַ֣יִם שִׁפְרָ֑ה חֹֽלֲלָ֥ה יָ֝ד֗וֹ נָחָ֥שׁ בָּרִֽיחַ׃

passages.text: Indeed, these are but the fringes of His ways; how faint is the whisper we hear of Him! Who then can understand the thunder of His power?”
passages.sermon:
God is powerful and wise.
We see only a small part of what God does.
We hear only a faint whisper about God.
No one can fully understand God's great power.
No one can grasp the thunder of His strength.
passages.original: הֶן־ אֵ֤לֶּה׀ קְצ֬וֹת דַּרְכּוֹ וּמַה־ שֵּׁ֣מֶץ דָּ֭בָר נִשְׁמַע־ בּ֑וֹ וְרַ֥עַם גְּבוּרָתוֹ מִ֣י יִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃ס
